title: Legionella Isolation Using Preincubation
description: R code and input data for statistical analyses and figure generation associated with a study on Legionella isolation from industrial wastewater treatment plants using pre-incubation to improve culturability. The R code is licensed under MIT, and the input data under CC BY 4.0.
